speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I understand you are presenting with a rash on your scalp and forehead. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have had this rash and if it is itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Psoriasis (infantile onset).

Given the family history of psoriasis and the scaly nature of the rash appearing in cold weather, I need to confirm if there is any family history of eczema or if the rash appears as well-defined red plaques with silvery scales. Please describe the exact appearance of the lesions and whether your baby has experienced any fever or joint stiffness.
